scientific_scope: Development-only feasibility and headroom qualification; no model request, no learning-effect result and no independent confirmation.

generation_gate.reason: All 24 draft tasks require conservative human semantic adjudication and the plan->evidence_lookup->consume contract is draft-only. No generation request is authorized.

eligibility_rule.task_need: Question contains an explicit 20xx period and the record has at least one same-company hard negative from a different filing year or document form.
eligibility_rule.reference_rule: At least one human-curated supporting passage and no exact text_sha1 overlap between supporting passages and hard negatives.

source_isolation.method: Ticker-level baseline plus conservative union across any exact text_sha1 shared by passages or hard negatives.
source_isolation.report_identity_limit: The release does not expose a stable filing report ID; ticker|year|form is a conservative report key and can merge multiple quarterly filings. Cross-report independence is UNRESOLVED and must not be claimed.

lexical_top_k.method: stopword-filtered question/passage token Jaccard; top-k with k=gold_count

visible_year_and_form_rule.method: candidate filing year equals last question year and candidate form equals record form

reference_quality.per_task_ambiguity_status: All 24 tasks are marked REQUIRES_HUMAN_SEMANTIC_ADJUDICATION; this script does not create or certify a new human gold label.
facts: FinRank README states that questions, answers, passages and hard negatives were manually authored.
FinRank README reports single annotator per record and no formal inter-annotator agreement.
No eligible record has exact text_sha1 overlap between a supporting passage and a hard negative.
The per-task check can identify potential visible alternatives but cannot rule out semantic alternative support without human adjudication.
human_semantic_adjudication_required_for: Any future case where multiple candidate passages can answer the question despite one recorded supporting-passage label.
Any task whose requested period or unit cannot be uniquely resolved from the question and visible passage text.

exposure.use_status: DEVELOPMENT_ONLY; not an unseen or pretraining-unseen confirmation set.

known_blockers_for_generation: No task-matched FinRank historical experience has been collected.
The plan->evidence_lookup->consume contract is a draft and has not been instantiated as a runner or fixture-tested.
The proposed experience gate and strong-rule/solved-example controls have not received independent scientific review.
No fixed runtime, prompt or raw-response contract has been frozen for this candidate.
Exact source-cluster independence beyond the conservative connected components is unresolved.
next_gate: Independent review of this qualification and the task draft; if unblocked, design a small task-matched history collection and B0. Do not issue a generation request from this artifact alone.
